description: Count nodes that have two empty children.
prompt: **Count nodes that have two empty children.**
program:
Inductive Tree = empty Unit | node {Int, Tree, Tree};

tree_pass = \v: Tree -> Int.
    let run = (fix (
    \f: Tree -> Compress Tree. \t: Tree.
    match t with
      empty _ -> align (label t)
    | node {w, l, r} ->
        let left = (f l) in
            let right = (f r) in
                align (label (node {w, unlabel left, unlabel right}))
    end
)) in
        \t: Tree.
        let copied = (run t) in
            align (v (unlabel copied));

leaf_count = fix (
    \f: Tree -> Int. \t: Tree.
    match t with
      empty _ -> 0
    | node {_, l, r} ->
        match l with
          empty _ -> match r with empty _ -> 1 | node {_, _, _} -> f r end
        | node {_, _, _} -> + (f l) (f r)
        end
    end
);
main = tree_pass leaf_count;

    let copy = (fix (
    \f: List -> Compress List. \xs: List.
    match xs with
      nil _ -> align (label xs)
    | cons {h, t} ->
        let tail = (f t) in
            align (label (cons {h, unlabel tail}))
    end
)) in
        \a: List. \b: List.
        let left = (copy a) in

description: Return the length of the common equal prefix of two integer lists.
prompt: **Return the length of the common equal prefix of two integer lists.**
program:
Inductive List = cons {Int, List} | nil Unit;

pair_pass = \v: List -> List -> Int.
    let copy = (fix (
    \f: List -> Compress List. \xs: List.
    match xs with
      nil _ -> align (label xs)
    | cons {h, t} ->
        let tail = (f t) in
            align (label (cons {h, unlabel tail}))
    end
)) in
        \a: List. \b: List.
        let left = (copy a) in
            let right = (copy b) in
                align (v (unlabel left) (unlabel right));

common_prefix = fix (
    \f: List -> List -> Int. \a: List. \b: List.
    match a with
      nil _ -> 0
    | cons {x, xs} ->
        match b with
          nil _ -> 0
        | cons {y, ys} -> if (== x y) then + 1 (f xs ys) else 0
        end
    end
);
main = pair_pass common_prefix;
